$description: Link design preview tokens (stage 1). Decided by the Design System Lead on 2026-11-04: one variant (default, color text.link), size inherited from the surrounding text, text only, always underlined. Hover: darker color text.link-hover (primary-700); pressed: text.link-pressed (primary-800) (Link exception to state layers). Visited: text.link-visited (primary-800). Focus: no outline, no state layer, thicker underline (border-width.2).

background.description: Background behind the text (context, not part of the link)
